# Main body dimensions
body_length = 200  # X-axis

body_height = 100  # Z-axis

# Windshield cutout dimensions
windshield_length = 50  # X-axis
windshield_width = 100  # Y-axis
windshield_height = 50  # Z-axis

# Wheel dimensions
wheel_radius = 25
wheel_thickness = 10

# Calculate windshield position (at the front edge of the car)
# Assuming the car body starts at origin (0,0,0)
windshield_x = body_length - windshield_length  # Position at the front edge
windshield_y = 0
windshield_z = body_height - windshield_height  # Position at the top

print(f"Main body: {body_length}x{body_width}x{body_height} mm at origin (0,0,0)")
print(f"Windshield cutout: {windshield_length}x{windshield_width}x{windshield_height} mm at ({windshield_x},{windshield_y},{windshield_z})")

# Calculate wheel positions
# Wheels at the four bottom corners, embedded as half-cylinders
# They should be oriented along Y-axis and point inward

# Front wheels
front_wheel_x = body_length - wheel_radius  # Near front edge
back_wheel_x = wheel_radius  # Near back edge

# Left wheels (positive Y direction)
left_wheel_y = body_width  # At the edge
left_wheel_base_z = wheel_radius  # Center at bottom edge

# Right wheels (negative Y direction)
right_wheel_y = 0  # At the edge
right_wheel_base_z = wheel_radius  # Center at bottom edge

print(f"\nWheel positions:")
print(f"Front-left wheel: base at ({front_wheel_x}, {left_wheel_y}, {left_wheel_base_z}), pointing inward (-Y)")
print(f"Front-right wheel: base at ({front_wheel_x}, {right_wheel_y}, {right_wheel_base_z}), pointing inward (+Y)")
print(f"Back-left wheel: base at ({back_wheel_x}, {left_wheel_y}, {left_wheel_base_z}), pointing inward (-Y)")
print(f"Back-right wheel: base at ({back_wheel_x}, {right_wheel_y}, {right_wheel_base_z}), pointing inward (+Y)")

# Height vectors for wheels
# Left wheels point in -Y direction (inward from left edge)
left_wheel_vector = (0, -wheel_thickness, 0)
# Right wheels point in +Y direction (inward from right edge)
right_wheel_vector = (0, wheel_thickness, 0)

print(f"\nWheel vectors:")
print(f"Left wheels vector: {left_wheel_vector}")
print(f"Right wheels vector: {right_wheel_vector}")
